summary: Added openOrReuse and validated CACHE_HIT recording to the gateway; review round 1 fixes applied (error handling, session ownership, input validation, tests).

produces.name: GatewaySessions.openOrReuse
produces.note: openOrReuse({feature,userId,projectId}): Promise<string>; reuses newest usable OPEN session else local open(); rethrows non NOT_FOUND/CONFLICT_STATE errors

produces.name: recordCacheHit
produces.note: recordCacheHit(input: CacheHitInput): Promise<void>; exported from @agile/llm-gateway; validates ids/role/hex hashes (INVALID_CACHE_HIT) and session ownership (NOT_FOUND); preview throws AI_NOT_CONFIGURED

produces.name: CacheHitInput
produces.note: type exported from @agile/llm-gateway; createCacheHits({db,settings,clock?}) also exported; inputHash/promptVersion must be 1-128 hex chars

next: T3: re-export recordCacheHit and type CacheHitInput from the gateway binding; call getSessions().openOrReuse.
